scenarios.name: migrate-webpack-config-to-turbopack
scenarios.rationale: Both give the correct turbopack.rules and resolveAlias config and say webpack plugins aren't supported with a --webpack fallback, but B states plainly that the webpack() function is ignored and should be deleted, while A says the build fails on it and then proposes keeping a gated webpack() function.

scenarios.name: fix-sass-functions-build-failure
scenarios.rationale: A states the Rust-cannot-call-JS reason, pins only the build to webpack while dev stays on Turbopack, and recommends rewriting as plain Sass or CSS variables, so it matches the rubric closely; B never gives the Rust/JS reason, is less committed to keeping dev on Turbopack, and offers CSS variables only among several follow-up options, though its CI advice is a useful extra.

scenarios.name: monorepo-linked-package-not-resolved
scenarios.rationale: A sets turbopack.root with path.join(__dirname, ".."), says the key moved to top-level turbopack as of 15.3, and gives the exact codemod command. B sets root correctly but never mentions the codemod or version 15.3, and it adds extras such as transpilePackages and outputFileTracingRoot that the rubric didn't ask for.
